summary:
Both major issues from round 1 are fully resolved. All four minors are also addressed.

**Major 1 — false-green `invalidTriggerValueWithSpaceReturns422` (RESOLVED)**
The test now sends `"triggers": [onStartTriggerMap("has space")]` (line 1373 in FunnelControllerIT). `onStartTriggerMap` serialises to `{"triggerType":"on_start","triggerValue":"has space"}` inside a `triggers` array, which is parsed by `UpdateFunnelRequest.triggers()` into a `List<TriggerDto>`. `applyTriggers` routes it through `normalizeOnStartValue`, which rejects "has space" against `TRIGGER_VALUE_PATTERN` (`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,64}$`) and throws 422 `funnel_invalid_trigger_value`. The test now actually exercises the validation path and is a true green.

**Major 2 — legacy IT bodies sending flat top-level trigger fields (RESOLVED)**
All ~20 occurrences of `"triggerValue": ""` have been migrated to `"triggers": List.of(onStartTriggerMap(""))` via the `onStartTriggerMap` helper. Every request body in the file that previously sent a silently-dropped flat field now sends a proper `triggers` array. Confirmed across lines 128, 160, 202, 1355–1710 range, and the two additional tests at ~1748/1779. No remaining flat `triggerValue` or `triggerType` top-level fields appear in the test PUT/POST bodies.

**Minor 1 — bareOnStartTrigger reuse (RESOLVED)**
The null/empty triggers normalisation in `applyTriggers` (line 681–685) now calls `bareOnStartTrigger()` directly, skips the DTO round-trip, and calls `syncOnStartTriggerValue` and returns early. The inline `new TriggerDto(TRIGGER_ON_START, "", null, null)` is gone.

**Minor 2 — comment on `saveHandlingTriggerConflict` (RESOLVED)**
The comment (lines 394–399) now reads: "The ONLY unique index on the `funnels` collection is that on_start (projectId, onStartTriggerValue) partial-unique index … (Unique indexes on OTHER collections, e.g. funnel_executions, never surface here.)" — removes the "ONLY unique index" ambiguity.

**Minor 3 — boundary test for array-size cap (RESOLVED)**
`triggers_arraySizeCapBoundaryAccepted` added to `FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest` (lines 208–217): 1 on_start + 49 distinct events = exactly 50 = MAX_TRIGGERS, asserts no exception thrown and persisted size is 50.

**Minor 4 — `patch_multipleOnStartReturns422` IT (RESOLVED)**
The test is present at lines 1265–1283 in `FunnelControllerIT`, sends two `on_start` elements, and asserts `status().isUnprocessableEntity()` + `jsonPath("$.code").value(FunnelService.CODE_MULTIPLE_ON_START)`. It covers the HTTP stack path distinct from the service-level test.

No new issues were identified in the diff or the current state of any file.
